meta.title: Contact
meta.description: Talk to Ponte. Post a deal on the board yourself, or bring one to the desk.

lead.default: Posting a deal does not need us: the board is free and open. Write when you want the desk involved, or when something is not working. We reply within one business day.

deal.title: Post a deal yourself
deal.body: An offer or a requirement, goods or trade services. Free to post, vetted by the desk before it goes live.

email.title: Email us
email.body: For anything the board does not cover: a question about a Deal Room, something that is not working, or a deal you would rather not put in public.
